newsitem.title: FRANCE: Saudis seen close to barley deal at $142 upwards.
newsitem.headline: Saudis seen close to barley deal at $142 upwards.

text.p: Saudi Arabia is edging close to finalising deals to buy one million tonnes of optional-origin barley at $142 per tonne and upwards, grain traders said on Wednesday.GRA
Saudi Arabia tendered on Tuesday for one million tonnes of optional-origin barley for September and October arrival.
Traders said the deal likely to take final shape overnight was for purchases starting at $142 per tonne including freight, which was the lowest offer received on Tuesday.
One trader said the highest offer likely to be accepted was $146 per tonne, while others put the cut-off one or two dollars per tonne higher.
Traders said earlier that final results were not expected until Thursday morning.

The barley -- the biggest shipments bought so far in the northern hemisphere new-crop campaign -- could be supplied from the European Union, Canada, the United States and Australia, although Canada had indicated it would not be a major supplier.
